Before treatment is attempted for an intact household pet or breeding dog, client must clearly agree that animal will be neutered and potentially euthanized if
Zoonotic infection is a possibility; discuss proper sanitation and prevention of exposure.

Tetracyclines—do not use in immature animals.
Gentamicin—6–15 mg/kg IM/SC q12h; limited success; insufficient data on efficacy combined with tetracycline.
Serologic tests—monthly at least 3 months after completion of treatment; continuous, persistent decline in antibodies to negative status indicates successful treatment.

Blood cultures—negative for at least 3 months after completion of treatment.
